prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Reordering sign-in after adoption (sign_in, reorder) was helpful (+7.0% in round 1), though a subsequent test showed no clear effect.
Streamlining path selection copy (choose_path, copy) significantly hurt performance (-4.7%).
Copy updates on completion (finish, copy) and new interactive flows (choose_path, new_flow) showed no clear effect.
Grid selection layouts (adoption, layout) and background notifications (finish, notification) showed no clear effect.
Estimated wait times, alerts, and waiting hints (home, wait_info / hint) showed no clear effect.
Predictions were consistently too optimistic across all tested changes.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, layout: +2.7% over 1 test(s)
- choose_path, copy: -4.7% over 1 test(s)
- choose_path, new_flow: +0.2% over 1 test(s)
- finish, copy: +3.7% over 1 test(s)
- finish, notification: +5.4% over 1 test(s)
- home, hint: +4.3% over 1 test(s)
- home, wait_info: -0.5% over 1 test(s)
- sign_in, reorder: +3.6% over 2 test(s)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 78.2%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 19.1%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [finish, new_screen] Pet Desktop Quick Tutorial Screen: Add a dedicated onboarding screen right after adoption detailing key desktop hotkeys, tray controls, and pet interaction methods. (why: 3 support emails reported confusion on how to control, hide, or talk to the pet after completing onboarding, contributing to the 64.8% finish step drop.)
1: [home, new_flow] Desktop Summon Test Flow: Introduce a quick interactive desktop verification flow within the waiting step allowing users to test pet responsiveness before finishing setup. (why: The waiting step has a long mean duration (2336s) and 3 support emails reported pets not displaying on desktop or app startup issues.)
2: [adoption, hint] Custom Photo Upload Quality Guidance Hint: Add a contextual hint guiding users on optimal photo lighting and clear backgrounds when generating custom pets. (why: 3 support emails reported custom pet generation failures or unexpected visual results during the photo upload step.)
3: [finish, copy] Pet Arrival Welcome Banner Copy: Update headline and body text to warmly celebrate completing setup and give clear reassurance that the pet is running safely in the desktop tray. (why: Drop-off at the final step is 64.8%, and users report uncertainty about whether the app is active on their desktop.)
4: [home, notification] Desktop Setup Progress Notification Toggle: Enable an optional desktop progress notification toggle during background pet generation tasks. (why: Home step has a median time of 201s and mean of 2336s, indicating users minimize or leave during waiting without clear progress alerts.)
